opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to fund multiple positions in a two-legged binary structure, including an account for a family member, and ties qualification to weekly earnings. It illustrates returns of 6% to 8% per week, claims approximately 50% in one year, at least 100% in two years, and says the income will continue for life. These are not merely abstract explanations: viewers are encouraged to place positions, generate referral and binary bonuses, and show the opportunity to friends. The recruitment-dependent structure and return claims actively solicit participation, including by involving family members and expanding the team.
